leadText:
Underground Showdown (Japanese: VS ワルビル VS Krokorok), titled VS Krokorok in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 493rd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 33rd chapter of the .

It is subtitled Krokorok (Japanese: 感知 Perception) in the VIZ Media translation and Underground Showdown in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
